prompt_shape.built_by: loop.run_turn with a scripted stand-in model
prompt_shape.cards: an item with cards preloads get_card on exactly those slugs, as the scorer does

shapes.direct: preload, then the target (no tool call): the preload shows the rule
shapes.lookup: preload, one search_rules call, its real result, then the target: the preload does not show the rule and the search does
shapes.lookup-call: the same item's first step: preload, then the target is the search call itself (mask_prompt trains only the last message, so without this row the call would never be trained)

prompt_shape.target: <think> short reasoning </think> + rule quote + one-line conclusion + Answer: X

engine_queries.attack-declare: attack with a ready Unit during your Main phase
engine_queries.attack-target: which rival Units can be attacked
engine_queries.block: when can a Unit use Blocker
engine_queries.play-from-hand: spend Eddies to pay the cost of a card
engine_queries.sell: sell a card with a Sell Tag

lookup.other_queries: the row's lookup_query, else the statement's first 8 content words (no function words, modals, negations or rule ids)
lookup.kept_only_if: the search result shows what the target quotes: the template's rule sentence word for word, or every cited rule id of a scenario or engine item

fallback_reasons: no rules index at data/processed/corpus_index.npz (build it on the Mac with scripts/build_rules_index.py)
preload_search.note: search_rules falls back to lexical BM25 when no usable rules index exists, as the scorer does; a build where data/processed/corpus_index.npz is usable would record 'hybrid' here

scenario-drafted.by: source rule ids (all must hash to the same split, else dropped as split-straddle)

gold_cards.rule: a scenario-drafted item whose cards include a slug in any gold set's cards field, or a card whose name with subtitle appears in a gold question or choice, is dropped (gold_card_dropped); engine items are only counted

leak_guard.method: normalised words (lowercase, brackets and punctuation removed); fails on a shared word 8-gram between any row's statement or target (a search call's query included) and any gold question or choice, or a difflib.SequenceMatcher ratio >= 0.8 between a statement and any gold question
